committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 16 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend fell to A$82.41 over the last 7 days from A$145.21, conversionsLast7 is 0, and the A$600 landing-page test credit is now fully spent (creditRemainingExGst A$0). Campaign status is already PAUSED, which lines up with the rule given review_cta_click still sits at 0 since the test started.

No external Google Ads account changes in the last 24 hours or 7 days (externalLast24h 0, externalLast7d 0), so the test numbers stay unconpromised. Rank lost sits at 76.3% against budget lost of only 14.5%, so impressions are being missed on rank, not budget.
Since the test began, ask_cta_click is at 17 and quick_question_click at 5, but review_cta_click is still 0: people are engaging the short question form, not the deeper booking step.

Organic Search sessions rose to 13 from 5 week on week, with google/organic up to 12 from 3, the only unpaid signal worth trusting. AI Assistant visits stayed at 0 again (aiVisits.last7 0, prior7 0), so the answer-engine work has no visible traffic outcome yet.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks have reached 108, well past the 75-click check point. Have Chris confirm relevant and qualified counts in the test log to see if the zero-qualified red flag applies.
The credit is exhausted and the campaign is already paused. Confirm whether cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or under with at least one qualified prospect booked before considering any restart.
Three generate_lead events have fired since the test started. Check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source details and grade each against the qualified rule in the test log.
Raw clicks are well past 25, so the headline, offer and calls to action stay frozen unless something breaks.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success. Update them to match current site stats.
